verdict.rationale: PayPal supports the underlying building blocks — webhooks for event notifications (paypal-docs-9/28), automated payment recovery for failed subscription payments (paypal-docs-40), automatic invoice payment reminders (paypal-docs-50), and an Agent Toolkit/MCP server with invoice/subscription tools including send_invoice_reminder (paypal-supp-agent-tools-inventory) — but there is no documented end-to-end agent workflow that specifically listens for failed-payment webhooks, triggers retries, and orchestrates dunning outreach as a single capability. missing for 10: an explicit agent-toolkit tool or example wiring failed-payment webhook events to automated retry/dunning logic, and independent evidence of this working in practice.
